data.title: 艾尔菲利亚 · 冰海浮台的夏日魔法
data.description: 【冰海温泉浮台·午后】艾尔菲利亚穿着冰蓝泳装坐在漂浮木台，脚边的海水凝成细小冰花；她一手举着冰镇果汁，一手让一只小冰鸟停在指尖，蓝瞳因为成功的魔法而闪亮。
data.location: floating platform on a magical ice sea
data.action: 冰海浮台上让海水绽成冰花，举果汁展示停在指尖的小冰鸟
data.lighting: bright afternoon light through crystalline spray
data.promptProse: Elfaria Alvis Serfort from Wistoria: Wand and Sword wears an ice-blue swimsuit with a white shoulder wrap, crystal hair clasp and a chilled fruit drink. She sits on the floating platform with a chilled fruit drink while tiny ice flowers bloom in the surrounding sea. A small frost bird lands on her finger, and her blue eyes brighten with delighted pride as she shows the spell to the viewer. bright afternoon light through crystalline spray.
